additional_considerations.rationale: Sudden unilateral lower abdominal pain with rebound and guarding fits, but it is less common than appendicitis or PID and would not explain a late period.
An uncommon cause of this presentation, usually associated with ovarian enlargement from a benign mass.
Causes crampy pain, nausea, vomiting, low-grade fever, and diarrhea, but rebound tenderness makes it less likely.
Crampy pain and spotting with an LMP 5 weeks ago raise the possibility, and fever suggests septic abortion, though the short interval makes it less likely.
Unlikely without chronic pelvic pain, dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia, or infertility; acute severe pain could come from a ruptured endometrioma.

source_issues: Exam line e004 reads '51152 WNL', an OCR artifact for 'S1/S2 WNL'.

Exam line e005 has garbled sign results: 'Ely's psoas sign', 'Ely's Rovsing sign', '6 obturator sign'. The direction of each sign is not legible; they are kept neutral (x012-x014). The SP notes and gold rank 1 treat psoas and Rovsing as positive (sp_notes records x019-x020); the obturator result is unknown.
The SP note describes Rovsing sign as RLQ pain 'when the examinee presses on the RLQ'; Rovsing sign is RLQ pain on pressure over the left lower quadrant. Kept as written (x019).
p021: asked about spotting since the last period, the patient says today is the first day of her menstrual period; the note and gold call it brownish spotting. Kept in her words (f023).
The note medication list gives only ibuprofen, although she uses oral contraceptive pills (p032).
The sample closure mentions 'a positive result on your pregnancy test', but no test result exists in the case; not added to investigations.
Gold rank 2 lists 'RLQ tenderness' (an exam finding) under history findings.
The note PMH 'possibly treated with ceftriaxone and doxycycline' is a clinician interpretation of 'a shot and some pills for a week'; patient facts keep her wording.
The raw Patient Description ('single with one child') is not in the parsed source fields; added to persona.acting_notes.
